title: Rain or Shine
subtitle: 考点：天气与物品 / Bring an umbrella and a raincoat.

dialogue.t: Lily, look at the sky. It will rain this afternoon.
But we are going on the school trip.
Don't worry. Bring an umbrella and a raincoat.
Is the raincoat in my room?
Yes, it is on the bed. And put on warm clothes.
OK. Is it fine in the morning?
Yes. It is fine in the morning, but there will be wind in the afternoon.

vocab: umbrella 雨伞 · raincoat 雨衣 · worry 担心 · fine 晴朗的 · wind 风 · bring 带来 · trip 旅行

questions.stem: What will the weather be like this afternoon?

questions.why: Bring an umbrella and a raincoat.
